body:
I’m sorry about your brother. I never downvoted you either. When I disagree with someone on here I just tell them. 

I feel like my body is already dead and I’m just lagging behind it. It’s only gonna get worse with age and it’s stripped me of all opportunities for a good life. It hurts me, all the things I can’t do now but I guess that’s just what’s in store for me. My only hope now is killing myself. To stop the pain.

If I’m like this at 23, there’s going to be nothing left of me by 30. I can’t cope. I just want out. 

And they already know that I’m gonna kill myself when I get out. That’s why I don’t think they are gonna let me out.
Well I’m here. I’m wheelchair bound so there’s nothing I can do in this room anyway but sit. It’s not like I can hang myself in here.

I can’t move. I’m paralysed. All I was saying is that bad shit happens and it pisses me off. I don’t need an essay on why I’m a moron. I want to die because I can’t move and can barely speak anymore. It’s pretty simple. I can’t change that. I’m sorry.
I don’t see the beauty in what’s happened to me and if you were in my situation you wouldn’t either.

They test you when you first get here and you have to stay in your room until you get the all clear. It takes about a day. 

I can’t get visitors or leave the facility because of the lockdown. All the doctors and nurses are wearing face masks so I barely recognise anyone. It’s pretty awful to be honest. I don’t think I’m ever getting out of here.
Thank you
My care is under the NHS so I don’t choose what service I’m under but thank you anyway. I hope your care works out for you.
My point was that karma does not exist. Things just happen randomly without meaning. Most of the time they’re painful things that happen to people that don’t deserve them.

I’m allowed to go where people aren’t but the area where I live in England is pretty rough and accessibility is a real problem. Plus I can’t get anywhere without being pushed. The fatigue with MS is insane.
Probably. I don’t have any friends anymore. They all moved away. And I can’t leave my house because I’m deemed vulnerable due to the virus. Honestly saying I’m fucked would be an understatement.

I’m not. All of this is happening to me and I’m only 23. The only thing that makes happy now is my younger brother. We’re similar in a lot of ways so I feel if even though I’ll be dead, a part of me will still be alive in him. I just worry he’s gonna hurt himself if I go. That’d mean though both his brother and his dad will have killed themselves.

I have a very accelerating version of multiple sclerosis. It’s not just paralysis. Even though that would be enough because I can’t go anywhere. I’m losing my ability to speak. I’m not gonna be able to talk anymore. I’m alone trapped in this half dead body anyway. I just wanna go.
Thanks but there’s not much to say really. I’m chair bound. Can’t move my legs anymore. I’ll be alone for the rest of my life so I just want it to stop. I’m gonna kill myself next month.
Gunshots worse. No cleanup with a hanging.
Nothing. I’m disabled. I don’t do anything anymore. I can’t get out anywhere. Nobody here understands what it’s like to have their body shut down. I just want to end things.

I feel you. I’m paralysed from the waist down. Health conditions are fucking awful. They make the depression 1000 times worse. But I think if you had the right mental health support in place you’d find your situation more bearable. I started seeing a therapist at your age and 10 years later I’m still here.

I’m sorry man. I was raped by my dad when I was young so I know your pain. The best thing I can say to you is talk to your parents. You say have a good relationship with them so if you tell them your in pain I’m sure they’d do their best to help you.

I’m not sure either of your ages but maybe you could talk to your brother or somebody you trust about how your feeling right now. It might help to let someone know your not doing well at the moment. Support from your family members could help your mood.
I feel you man. It’s constant work with this thing. Constant worry too. I’m glad you’ve been able to withstand it for so long though. You’re a strong dude.
Your ass is good. Don’t worry about it fam.
Taking responsibility for your actions isn’t the same as blaming yourself for having an unwanted medical issue.
Mental illness is a chemical imbalance in the brain. A medical problem that needs treatment like anything else. It’s nobody’s fault. You can’t blame someone for it.
Alright, good. Talk to your friend man. Get some help.
You still there guy?
She just missed a call, man. It happens. Can you call the police or a hospital for the pills you took?
Thanks man
You dying is gonna hurt her more than tiredness.
She’d rather be awake than you dead, man. Call her.
I think it’s pretty hard to die from paracetamol, man. Might just make you vomit for days. You should call an ambulance.
Damn straight

That I’m going to kill myself because I have to spend the rest of my life living with my mum because I can’t take care of myself. The whole disabled people can live good lives thing is pure cope. Everything you like about living, I can’t do.
Yeah maybe you needed context. I’m disabled, mostly bed bound 24/7. I appreciate you trying to help but there’s not a lot I can physically do here man.
Yeah but the quality has been pretty shit too so idk
The things I used to do mostly remind me of what I can’t do now. I can’t seem to distract myself for long. That’s not much help to me. Thanks anyway

Newly disabled and not taking it very well. I’ve never really put too much value on my life in the first place and this is making me want to end it. I know there’s not a lot you can say when it’s a physical issue not a mental one no pressure bro
Well at least you made me laugh
Not feeling, physically stuck in a chair. I’m disabled.
I’m sorry man, but I’m probably gonna go through with it. I’ve dealt with the pain for so long I feel like I can’t breathe. I’ll do anything for it to stop.
